_comment: Hosts .claude/hooks/guard-network.sh will let through. Everything else is
denied outright - that is the point: AGENTS.md rule 2 says IoCs in this repo
are live, and a permission allow-list cannot express 'deny everything else'.
Add a host only for documentation or package-registry lookups. NEVER add a
domain that came out of shared/, MISP, a report, or a feed, however harmless
it looks - those are the indicators this lab exists to handle.
A leading '*.' matches any subdomain at any depth, and does not match the
bare domain; list the bare domain separately if you need it.
THREE lists have to agree, and nothing enforces that for you:
1. this file          - the hook, the only deny-by-default one
A host missing from any one of them is refused there, not silently allowed,
so drift shows up as an unexplained block. Add a host to all three.
